package.name: openamrobot_upperbody_mujoco
package.description: MuJoCo model of OpenAMRobot 2.0, generated from combined_robot.xacro at build time (the same robot as Gazebo and MoveIt): actuators from the URDF limits and the pinned OpenArm control gains, the finger mimic, head and wrist cameras, the MoveIt collision exclusions, a wheeled or fixed base, lift keyframes and a basic scene; tests that it matches the URDF.
